label: Version III
title: Rayo Joakin Cup III
overview: The competition evaluates how modular, adaptable, and robust each team’s embedded system is. Vehicles must support configuration on event day through software parameters or serial commands.
platform: Raspberry Pi 5 with a Tiva C or Raspberry Pi Pico W

modules.title: Real-Time Visual Tracking & Closed-Loop Control

challenge.name: Lead and Follow

visual.alt: A following vehicle tracks a lead vehicle along a route and maintains the assigned distance.
visual.caption: Illustration only. The depicted attempts, route, and marker are examples pending confirmation.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.text: Two vehicles run together. The leader drives the assigned movement pattern. The follower tracks the leader and tries to maintain the assigned distance, in centimeters, throughout the run.

sections.heading: What to prepare
sections.text: Configure your vehicle to perform both roles. Be ready to load the movement pattern for leading and set the target distance for following.

sections.heading: How to win
sections.text: The vehicle with the best combined performance as leader and follower wins.

pending: How lead and follow performance are measured and combined

modules.description: Use HSV color segmentation on the Raspberry Pi 5 to detect the target and estimate its offset and distance. Send the measurements over serial to a proportional or PID differential controller. Follow a moving target at 25–45 cm while maintaining sight and avoiding collisions during sudden stops.

modules.title: Visual State Machine & Timed Actuation (Timed FSM)

challenge.name: Recognize and React

visual.alt: A vehicle scans colored shapes and then performs a sequence of movements.
visual.caption: Illustration only. The rounds, cue mappings, and procedure shown are examples pending confirmation.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.text: Your vehicle reads visual cues made up of colors and shapes. For each cue, identify the color and shape, then execute the action assigned to that combination.

sections.heading: What to prepare
sections.text: Be ready to configure which action the vehicle performs for each cue.

pending: Colors, shapes, and the action assigned to each cue
Cue presentation, sequence length if applicable, and when to start executing
How recognition and execution will be scored

modules.description: Recognize and store a sequence of colors under varying lighting. Translate it into an ordered action queue and use the microcontroller to execute moves and LED patterns with configurable durations received over serial.

modules.title: Reactive Arena Navigation & Perimeter Boundary Safety

challenge.name: Clear the Arena

visual.alt: Two separate arenas, each with a vehicle clearing target objects while detecting the boundary.
visual.caption: Illustration only. The time limit, boundary measurements, and fallback scoring shown are examples pending confirmation.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.text: Two teams compete, each with one vehicle in its own arena. Find and clear every object that matches the announced target color or shape while keeping your vehicle inside its boundary.

sections.heading: What to prepare
sections.text: Prepare your vehicle to identify the target and respond when it approaches the perimeter.

sections.heading: How to win
sections.text: The first team to clear all its targets wins.

pending: What counts as clearing an object, the time limit, and how boundary violations affect the result

modules.description: Sweep rotationally to center a target in the camera frame. Give floor reflectance or forward distance sensors priority on the microcontroller. When the vehicle detects the boundary, interrupt navigation, brake, reverse, and turn away before resuming the search.

modules.title: Real-Time Wireless Teleoperation

challenge.name: Vehicle Soccer

visual.alt: Two remote-controlled vehicles approach a ball at the center of a field with a goal at each end.
visual.caption: Illustration only. The match length, lineup, and overtime rules shown are examples pending confirmation.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.text: Drive your vehicle by remote control and score by moving the ball into the opposing goal.

sections.heading: What to prepare
sections.text: Prepare your wireless controls for quick changes in direction and speed so you can approach the ball, line up a shot, and defend your goal.

pending: Scoring, restart rules, and permitted contact

modules.description: Control throttle and steering with low latency over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi using a controller, smartphone, or PC.

announcements: Open each challenge for its instructions and details awaiting release, including target colors, sequence lengths, arena dimensions, vehicle soccer rules, and remaining evaluation details.
